name: Tonic
description: Restores 20 HP.

name: Strong Tonic
description: Restores 60 HP.

name: Remedy
description: Cures any status.

name: Spark Drop
description: Restores 5 Energy to the active Spirling.

name: Revival Leaf
description: Revives a Spirling outside battle with half HP.

name: Kin Charm
description: Hold it out during a bond to steady the link (+10%).

name: Grapple Line
description: Tamer Gear. Face a far post across narrow water and press A to pull yourself over.
hint: The far side is just out of reach. A grapple line could bridge it.

name: Climbing Pick
description: Tamer Gear. Face a low cliff and press A to climb up or down it.
hint: A steep rock face. With a climbing pick you could get a grip.

name: Storm Lantern
description: Tamer Gear. Lights pitch-dark places so you can walk through them.
hint: It's pitch dark ahead. A lantern would help.

name: Spark Coil
description: Held. The holder gains 1 extra Energy every turn.

name: Bark Wrap
description: Held. The holder recovers a little HP at the end of each turn.

name: Iron Burr
description: Held. Physical hits on the holder deal 15% less damage.

name: Swift Feather
description: Held. Raises the holder's SPD by 15%.

name: Keen Lens
description: Held. The holder lands keen hits twice as often.

name: Max Tonic
description: Restores all HP.

name: Cooling Gel
description: Cures Scorch.

name: Dry Towel
description: Cures Soak.

name: Wake Bell
description: Cures Drowse.

name: Power Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's ATK in battle.

name: Guard Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's DEF in battle.

name: Focus Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's FOC in battle.

name: Dash Brew
description: Raises the active Spirling's SPD in battle.

name: Tide Pearl
description: A pearl that hums with the sea. Some Spirlings change when they hold it close.

name: Spark Charm
description: Brightens one Spark value of a Spirling (+3).

name: Echo Crystal: Flare Lash
description: Teaches Flare Lash to an Ember Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Brine Jet
description: Teaches Brine Jet to a Tide Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Sap Draw
description: Teaches Sap Draw to a Bloom Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Surge Fang
description: Teaches Surge Fang to a Volt Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Quake Stomp
description: Teaches Quake Stomp to a Stone Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Cyclone Edge
description: Teaches Cyclone Edge to a Gale Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Prism Ray
description: Teaches Prism Ray to a Lumen Spirling. Never used up.

name: Echo Crystal: Gloom Pulse
description: Teaches Gloom Pulse to an Umbra Spirling. Never used up.
